cells.name: Listening dish
cells.description: A listening post's dish on its turntable, four cells across: the radar dish master drawn at an installation's scale. Stand-in until a dish of its own is drawn.

cells.name: Oxygen sphere
cells.description: A pressurised gas sphere on its valve manifold, two cells across: the fluid tank master at a store's scale. Oxygen or fuel for a post on airless ground.
